svg.title: Obelisk SFU
svg.desc: A lime SFU node in the middle of six call participants: whoever speaks sends one stream in, and the SFU fans it out to everyone else.

g.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: One stream up, fanned out to everyone in the call.
